detail.statement: Computational creativity frameworks require robust integration between formulation and evaluation components, supported by active inference and drift-diffusion mechanisms, for agents to autonomously navigate and identify novel, worthwhile problems.
detail.reason: Updated with recent active inference and interactive problem-formulation evidence supporting the link between internal evaluation signals and autonomous problem selection.

detail.title: Integrating Problem Formulation and Evaluation in Computational Creativity
detail.summary: This cycle reviews and updates beliefs regarding computational creativity and active inference. By re-evaluating belief-creativity-integration-01 with recent evidence, we underscore the necessity of coupling formulation with evaluative feedback mechanisms in autonomous problem identification.
